deterministic: byte-stable; wall-clock measurements live in census_cost.json

G0_quote_coverage_L_EV.rule: quote-present share of ATLAS member-days >= 0.80 (else L-EV runs on the covered subset and says so on its face)

G0_store_completeness.rule: trades store covers every panel day

G1_reconstruction.rule: for every checked member-day the U-path minute set inside [entry_et, session_end] equals the committed derived bars' minute set

read_passes.bars: only under --bars-check: one (ticker, et) read per day for the G1 reconciliation against the committed derived bars
read_passes.coverage: one JSON read per day, for the raw-sufficiency class
read_passes.quotes: one symbol-column scan per day, for quote_present
read_passes.trades: ONE projected-column scan per day (basket_subminute_probe.load_prints); the U-path filter runs on that frame in memory

reconciliation_notes: the census is a coverage/feasibility table: no feature is computed here
prints are counted inside [entry_et, session_end] of the member's own panel window, so a member-day's counts are family-specific when A_pm and B600 share the path
quote presence is the raw quote file's symbol list, not the candidate snapshots
bytes = the raw file sizes of the day files read (an upper bound: 6 of 8 columns are projected)
stage: A — census (one projected-column pass per dev day)

universe.U_all: every print of the member's symbol inside [entry_et, session_end]
universe.U_path: prints kept by basket_t5_rawpaths.price_updating (sip_bars.combine strictest-rule-wins) — the panel's own substrate
universe.window: member window = [entry_et, session_end] of the member's own panel rows
